words.prose: {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) is the opening negator in a restriction frame, not a conditional marker. It makes exclusion the first processing demand of the ayah and keeps the clause suspended until {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) and {{ar:نَذِيرٌ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun}}) identify the one role left standing. Because its scope reaches the final predicate, the clause does not deny the addressee; it strips away surplus roles and confines the mission to warning. Its small indeclinable form carries clause-level force without lexical description, while the repeated n-sound across {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}), {{ar:أَنتَ}} ({{tr:anta}}), and {{ar:نَذِيرٌ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun}}) makes the grammatical binding audible. After the limit stated in (35:22), this opening turns incapacity language into a positive office boundary.

It stands as its own particle before {{ar:نَذِيرٌ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun}}), so the final noun is not an afterthought to a completed negative clause; it is the predicate licensed by the exception. words.prose: {{ar:نَذِيرٌ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun}}) is the final content word and the restricted predicate of {{ar:أَنتَ}} ({{tr:anta}}). Because it follows {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}), it bears the whole clause weight as the one office left after exclusion: a personal warner, not a coercive controller of response. The objectless predicate names the function without specifying the audience or outcome, so the role is prior notice before consequence rather than management of reception. The advance-scout image makes that notice concrete: the warner alerts like a lookout or rider before harm reaches the camp, but does not become the force producing that harm. Its indefinite nominative form and qualitative pattern make warning a settled role-quality and an open functional class, while the nominal clause frames identity rather than a single act. That nominative predicate also contrasts with the accusative mission complement in (35:24), where the same warning word sits inside sending language rather than serving as the identity predicate. The selected root field is warning that awakens caution; the vow branch can add solemn accountability as background, but local grammar keeps the meaning on warning, not vow-making or wound compensation. Other family forms sharpen the contrast: the ayah does not choose Form II repeated-warning intensity or a more overt Form IV agentive participle like the form used in (13:7); it keeps those pressures as contrast while selecting the qualitative role noun. Unlike (13:7), the restriction here is staged analytically: negation strips alternatives before the exception lets the role land. The ayah also does not speak of plural warning-portents, but concentrates that field into one role-bearer. The same root then sits in a local thread with (35:24), (35:37), and (35:42), while (35:24) immediately expands the compressed role into a fuller sending formula. The final cadence and n-sound reprise make this warning noun the audible resolution of the whole restriction frame.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restrictive construction and the sole rooted noun at word 4 present the addressee as a nadhir.
baseline_models.mechanism: A danger notice is delivered so that caution can awaken; the restriction confines the addressee-facing function to giving that alert.

activation_trace.role: Threat-notice that awakens caution supplies both the literal warning and its alerting function in the clause.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root at word 4 also carries a form-distant self-obligation branch, while the restrictive syntax presents a person confined to one charge.
baseline_models.mechanism: At root level, self-binding obligation faintly recasts the title as an undertaken duty to keep warning, not merely a description of message content.

activation_trace.role: Self-imposed obligation supplies an exploratory duty-frame for the restrictive identification.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warning becomes a counter-perceptual intervention: it interrupts an attractive but unstable surface before mis-seeing bad action as good can settle into conduct.

activation_trace.role: The caution-awakening alert anchors the focus as an intervention in risk perception.
Deception by what gleams without holding supplies the misleading surface that the alert must puncture.
Making something appear beautiful supplies the active cosmetic operation by which bad action gains appeal.

structural_cues: 35:5 repeats the prohibition against deception, and 35:8 stages beautification, perception as good, and the addressee's grief before the focus restriction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deceptive shine, beautification, and seeing evil as good; I infer that warning counter-calibrates perception rather than merely adding threat information. A live alternative is that it only announces the outcome while guidance remains a separate act.

changed_reading.before: The warner reports an external danger.
changed_reading.after: The warner also disrupts the visual and evaluative process by which danger has been made to look desirable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning addresses an agent whose burden and purification remain personal: the messenger can awaken caution but cannot carry, cleanse, or answer in the recipient's place.

activation_trace.role: The alert that awakens caution supplies the messenger's bounded contribution to another person's response.
A heavy burden supplies the responsibility that cannot be transferred from one moral agent to another.

The explicit act of warning links the focus office to recipients characterized by awakened caution.
Fear joined with awe supplies the receptive orientation in which the warning takes effect.

The very self of the person supplies the beneficiary and owner of purification.

structural_cues: 35:18 moves from repeated burden non-transfer, through 'you warn only', to repeated self-purification for oneself.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-transferable burden, selective warning, and self-benefiting purification; I infer that the restriction in 35:23 bounds the messenger's agency at the edge of the recipient's own response. A live alternative is that 35:18 concerns final liability without directly defining messenger agency.

changed_reading.before: The restriction merely limits the speaker's job description.
changed_reading.after: It marks an ethical boundary: warning can address and awaken, but response, burden, and purification remain the hearer's own.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning is a perceptible signal, not a power that manufactures perception, life, or compliance; paired capacities and their absences determine uptake.

activation_trace.role: The danger signal supplies communicative input while leaving the hearer's receptive capacity outside the office.
Loss of sight supplies one pole of the immediate capacity contrast.
Actual seeing supplies the contrasted capacity by which a disclosed distinction can be taken in.
Possession of life supplies the responsive side of the living/dead contrast.
Loss of force and life supplies the extreme image of unavailable uptake.
Causing another to hear supplies the precise causal power denied to the addressee.

structural_cues: The paired contrasts of 35:19-22 culminate in inability to make grave-dwellers hear, immediately before the restrictive focus clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired capacities and the explicit inability to make those in graves hear; I infer that warning transmits a signal but cannot create receptive life or compliance. A live alternative is that the grave image is strictly eschatological rather than an analogy for present moral unresponsiveness.

changed_reading.before: A successful warning should make its audience change.
changed_reading.after: The office is fulfilled by making the alert available; actual hearing and compliance depend on a receptivity the warner cannot compel.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah expands the restricted identity into a truth-backed, recurrent messenger office that carries both good news and warning to communities across passing generations.

It remains anchored in n-dh-r and is activated by the sequence of truth-backed warning, taking for wrongdoing, sufficient time to remember, earned conduct, and an appointed term. Render it as a juridical-material analogy in which prior notice makes liability assessable, never as a claim that the noun literally means wound or compensation here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The n-dh-r root at focus word 4 through its assessed-wound branch, with the focus restriction isolating the act that precedes accounting.

activation_trace.role: A wound carrying an obligatory assessed claim supplies the exploratory analogy of warning as liability-marking notice.
A fixed obligation or entitlement supplies the juridical edge of the truth-backed commission.
Taking for wrongdoing supplies enforcement after the warning-and-evidence sequence.
The warning's arrival during sufficient lifetime supplies prior notice within the liability analogy.
Accountability-taking for wrongdoing supplies the later claim made legible by prior notice.
Personal acquisition supplies the acts to which the assessed consequence attaches.
A fixed term supplies the due boundary at which deferred accounting arrives.

changed_reading.before: Warning is information about possible harm.
changed_reading.after: As a contained branch analogy, warning also marks a claim before enforcement, making later accountability for acquired acts assessable rather than unannounced.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps a speech office onto the material movement of wind, cloud, and revived land. It remains anchored in the focus warning branch and in 35:9's chain of sending, stirring, driving, and enlivening; 35:22 prevents treating the analogy as guaranteed conversion. Render it as a transport-and-activation model for how an alert enters a receptive field, not as the lexical meaning of nadhir or a claim that the messenger gives life.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun as a delivered caution-awakening signal whose effect depends on the field it enters.

activation_trace.role: The delivered danger signal supplies the focus-side element compared with a moving atmospheric activation.
Dispatch and outward movement supply the first transport step of the material analogy.
Moving wind supplies the carrier that crosses space before any visible result.
Stirring a thing from its place supplies latent activation rather than completed transformation.
A cloud drawn along supplies the gathered medium made mobile by the dispatched wind.
Driving onward supplies directional transfer toward the field that may receive the effect.
Land coming alive through rain and growth supplies the endpoint that motivates, but does not guarantee, the warning analogy.

changed_reading.before: The warning is a static utterance aimed at an individual hearer.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, it is a dispatched signal that travels, stirs dormant potential, and drives toward response while remaining distinct from the power that gives life.

strongest_changes: The adjacent pairing of good news and warning moves the focus restriction away from threat-only content and toward bounded messenger agency within a universal office.
The burden, purification, sight, hearing, life, and grave sequences make warning non-transferable and reception-dependent rather than coercively effective.
The lifespan, remembrance, oath, aversion, historical pattern, earned conduct, and term sequences turn warning into finite prior notice and a diagnostic event.
summary.what_was_special: The focus root's ordinary alert branch connected several causal domains, while its self-obligation and assessed-wound branches became live only under the later oath and accountability sequences; the dispatched-weather sequence preserved a separate material analogy.
remaining_uncertainties: The restriction may locally foreground warning more narrowly even though the next ayah broadens the commission to good news and warning.
The hearing and grave contrast may be strictly eschatological rather than a model of present moral receptivity.
The oath, assessed-liability, and weather readings are contained root or domain resonances, not direct lexical substitutions.

identity_judgment.rationale: Branch phrase correctly treats the sense as a person placing a non-obligatory matter on themself as a binding duty. The supplied claim repeatedly frames the act as making something required on oneself, including a vow directed to God or a conditional promise.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: The branch is self-imposed obligation, not warning communication and not injury compensation except by the broad idea of becoming due.

lexicalization_scope.note: The mechanical scope keeps the bare noun, the verb, and constructions such as making it for God or on oneself together while preventing those constructions from becoming a general promise sense.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin kendisine daha önce zorunlu olmayan bir şeyi gerekli ve bağlayıcı bir yükümlülük yapmasıdır. Bu yükümlülük Tanrı'ya yönelik bir adak, kişinin kendi üzerine aldığı söz veya bir şarta bağlanan vaat olarak gerçekleşebilir.

facets.statement: Kişi kendi üzerine önceden zorunlu olmayan bir işi bağlayıcı yükümlülük haline getirir.
Yükümlülük Tanrı'ya yöneltilen bir adak ya da kişinin kendi üzerine aldığı bağlayıcı söz olabilir.
Bazı kullanımlarda yükümlülük, belirli bir olay gerçekleşirse yerine getirilecek şartlı söz biçimindedir.
Adak yoluyla ibadethane hizmetine ayrılan çocuk adlandırması, yükümlülüğün sonucuna bağlı özel kullanımdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Branch phrase frames the sense as a wound that has a required compensatory amount, and the supplied claim supports that by restricting the use to injury payments, named wound cases, and a single wound with an owed amount. This is not the devotional vow branch, even though both can involve something becoming due.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: The branch is restricted to compensation owed for wounds, not a general vow, warning, or ordinary injury description.

lexicalization_scope.note: The mechanical scope keeps the injury-payment lexical unit and the named wound collocation within a restricted legal sense, without generalizing it to every wound or every due payment.

facets.statement: Bir yaralama için ödenmesi gereken karşılık veya bedel çekirdeğini taşır.
Kullanım özellikle küçük-büyük yaralarda ve tek bir yaranın karşılığı bulunduğunda geçer.
Aynı karşılık için bazı hukuk çevrelerinde başka bir teknik ad bulunduğu belirtilir.
Kemiği açığa çıkaran yara için belirli bir pay gibi örnekler, bedelin yara türüne bağlandığını gösterir.
